summary.text: Utah State Extension names steaming or broiling as the best ways to cook green beans.

selection.text: Buy loose beans when you can, rather than pre-packaged in a bag.
Choose beans that are pliable or flexible rather than tough.

storage.text: Refrigerate fresh beans for about 5 to 7 days.
Store unwashed beans in an airtight bag to prevent moisture loss and wilting.
Wait to wash beans until you are ready to use them.

preparation.text: Cut or break off the tips at both ends.
Cut away any damaged or discolored areas.
Rinse the beans under running water, snapping or cutting off the ends if desired.

methods.label: Steam

why.text: Utah State names steaming, with broiling, as the best way to cook green beans.

equipment: Frying pan or pot with lid

steps.text: Clean the beans under warm running water.
Place the beans in a steamer set in a frying pan with about 2 inches of water.
Cover and boil about 5 minutes, until the spears are tender.

tips.text: Microwave steaming takes 2 to 5 minutes, depending on the amount of beans.
Use ½ inch to 1 inch of water in the dish when microwaving.

doneness.text: Done when the spears are tender.

why.text: Choose broiling for light browning; Utah State says to cook until the beans start to lightly brown.

steps.text: Preheat the broiler and line a cookie sheet with foil.
Spread the beans in a single layer and lightly spray both sides with olive oil.
Season with ¼ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon black pepper.
Broil about 8 minutes, until the beans begin to brown lightly.
Turn the beans and broil the other side for 5 to 8 minutes.

tips.text: Turn the beans with a spatula after the first side browns.

doneness.text: Beans should start to lightly brown on the first side.

why.text: Choose roasting for a seasoned oven side; the Oregon Food Hero recipe uses a 425 F oven.

steps.text: Snap or trim the ends if desired, then rinse the beans under running water.
Lay the beans on a metal baking sheet.
Drizzle with oil, salt and pepper, then toss to coat.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes, stirring a couple of times.

tips.text: Try garlic powder, lemon zest or Parmesan as seasoning variations.

doneness.text: Roast for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring a couple of times.

methods.label: Blanch (for freezing)

why.text: Blanch green beans before freezing; blanching slows enzyme action that dulls flavor, color and texture.

quantities.label: Blanch time (snap, green or wax beans)

equipment: Blanching basket with lid, or wire basket in a large pot

steps.text: Use about one gallon of water for each pound of beans and bring it to a vigorous boil.
Lower the beans into the boiling water and start timing once the water boils again.
Cool the beans in cold water for about the same time as blanching.

tips.text: Use cold water at 60°F or below, or ice water, for cooling.
